description.zh: 查询的结束时间，单位：秒。如果不设置该参数，结束时间为当前的查询时间。
description.en: The end of the time range to query. Unit: seconds. If you do not specify this parameter, the end time is the current query time.

description.zh:
WAF实例的ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeInstance](~~433756~~)查询当前WAF实例的ID。
description.en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) to query the ID of the current WAF instance.

description.zh: 时间间隔，单位：秒。取值为60的整数倍。
description.en: The time interval. Unit: seconds. The value must be an integer multiple of 60.

description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

description.zh: 查询的开始时间，单位：秒
description.en: The beginning of the time range to query. Unit: seconds.

description.zh:
响应码类型。取值：
- **waf**：表示WAF返回给客户端的响应码。
- **upstream**：表示源站返回给WAF的响应码
description.en:
The type of response codes. Valid values:
- **waf**: response codes returned by WAF to clients.
- **upstream**: response codes returned by origin servers to WAF.
